caseName: Windham v. First Gibralter Bank, F.S.B.
caseNameFull: L.B. WINDHAM v. FIRST GIBRALTER BANK, F.S.B.

opinions.text: The motion of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation as Manager of the FSLIC Resolution Fund to be substituted for First Gi-bralter Bank as respondent granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.
